اشتئين (form VIII)
# اُشْتُئِينَ (uštuʔīna) /uʃ.tu.ʔiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
# اِشْتَئِينَ (ištaʔīna) /iʃ.ta.ʔiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِشْتَأَى (ištaʔā)
